entries.role: Observe one final peer-owned Store snapshot through the versioned adapter subscription seam.
suppliedCapabilities: idempotent unsubscribe for the already-owned adapter subscription
committed reads that do not sample dormant external sources
allowedExternalWork: framework scheduling or render invalidation outside Valdres
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError; a read that would publish a dormant external source throws DormantExternalReadError. One callback error cannot starve the remaining frozen delivery snapshot.
entries.thenableRule: The subscriber is not awaited and no asynchronous Valdres capability survives delivery.
entries.resultBoundary: subscribe returns one idempotent unsubscribe and admits no delivery wrapper, batching hook, Transaction, Store ID, or adapter options.

entries.role: Resolve one StoreTree fallback synchronously on first required read.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. A thrown non-thenable becomes the owning fallback error outcome under the ordinary initializer rule.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes InvalidSynchronousAtomValueError and receives one rejection-containment handler.
entries.resultBoundary: Exactly one synchronous value or error outcome is memoized at the owning fallback only when the approved read/commit path consumes it.

entries.role: Compare one prior Atom value with one synchronous Set/update candidate before intent admission.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw rejects the operation before an intent is admitted; RuntimeMismatchError remains the exact sticky control fault.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes InvalidAtomComparatorResultError and is never awaited or tested for truthiness.
entries.resultBoundary: The comparator returns exactly true or false; every other result becomes InvalidAtomComparatorResultError. True canonicalizes Set/update to the transaction baseline value; false admits the candidate. Reset never calls it.

entries.role: Build one pure synchronous derived outcome and dependency proposal.
suppliedCapabilities: revocable supplied get for readable same-domain State
entries.errorRule: Forbidden captured same-domain Store work and use of the supplied get after revocation throw SelectorCapabilityError. Ordinary errors become stable selector error proposals; RuntimeMismatchError is a sticky host control fault and cannot be caught into a value.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes the named invalid synchronous selector outcome with one rejection-containment handler; it is never awaited or served.
entries.resultBoundary: The evaluator returns one immutable value/error/control proposal with its synchronously captured valid dependency prefix. A disposable or pre-apply host rejects a control proposal without publication; a persistent post-apply host installs the exact control outcome as authoritative current state.

entries.role: Compare one previous selector value with one fully evaluated next proposal without changing its dependency capture.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden captured same-domain Store work or use of a captured supplied selector get throws SelectorCapabilityError. A thrown non-thenable becomes the proposal's stable comparator error outcome; RuntimeMismatchError is a sticky exact host control fault and cannot be caught into a boolean or ordinary error proposal.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes the named invalid synchronous comparator error outcome with one rejection-containment handler; it is never awaited or tested for truthiness.
entries.resultBoundary: The comparator must return exactly true or false; every other synchronous result becomes a named invalid comparator result error proposal. Exactly true canonicalizes the accepted proposal to the prior successful value and reuses its served token only while that success is still the current served outcome; an equal error-to-value recovery receives a new token. Exactly false accepts the next value. Every accepted value or error proposal retains the complete synchronously captured dependency set.

entries.role: Stage one synchronous same-StoreTree TreeTransaction and return its result after commit.
allowedExternalWork: ordinary synchronous application work that does not require rollback
entries.errorRule: Forbidden captured same-domain work throws TransactionPhaseError. An escaping error aborts the TreeTransaction; a caught direct operation error preserves earlier valid intents in the same draft.
entries.thenableRule: A returned thenable is rejected synchronously as InvalidTransactionCallbackResultError after preserving only its synchronous-prefix intents for outer catch semantics; the cursor closes when the outer callback exits.
entries.resultBoundary: The callback result is returned only after successful preflight, apply, propagation, and settlement.

entries.role: Lexical sugar over one existing TreeTransaction cursor target.
suppliedCapabilities: targeted Transaction cursor sharing the outer draft
allowedExternalWork: same work allowed to the outer transaction callback
entries.errorRule: Forbidden captured same-domain work throws TransactionPhaseError. An escaping error follows the outer transaction abort rule; an outer catch preserves prior shared-draft intents.
entries.thenableRule: A thenable becomes InvalidTransactionCallbackResultError under the same synchronous rule as the outer transaction callback.
entries.resultBoundary: Returns the synchronous callback result and leaves every same-Tree cursor active until the outer transaction exits.

entries.role: Compute a replacement value from one current Atom value.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw rejects the operation before its intent is admitted.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes InvalidSynchronousAtomValueError and is never staged.
entries.resultBoundary: Called exactly once; its valid synchronous result becomes the one staged Atom value intent, including undefined when that belongs to the Atom value type, and the public mutation returns void.

entries.role: Compute a replacement value from one effectively present collection row.
entries.errorRule: Effective absence throws MissingCollectionRowError before the updater is invoked; forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError; any other updater throw rejects before intent admission.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable is a named invalid synchronous updater failure and is never staged.
entries.resultBoundary: Called exactly once for a present row; a valid non-undefined result becomes the one staged Present value intent and the public mutation returns void.

entries.role: Create one immutable State definition for an identity tuple cache miss.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw creates no family member and is not cached.
entries.thenableRule: A thenable rejects as an invalid family factory result; the factory must synchronously return a same-domain State.
entries.resultBoundary: One valid same-domain State subtype is weakly memoized for the canonical identity tuple.

entries.role: Map a richer argument tuple to one primitive SameValueZero identity key.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw creates and caches nothing.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable rejects as an invalid synchronous encoder result.
entries.resultBoundary: A valid JavaScript primitive becomes the sole identity key; original rich inputs are not retained by the family cache.

entries.role: Map one richer row lookup input to the canonical portable scalar row key.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw or invalid scalar creates no row handle and is not cached.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable rejects as an invalid synchronous collection-key encoder result.
entries.resultBoundary: A valid string, finite number, bigint, boolean, or null is canonicalized before row-handle memoization; original input is not retained.

entries.role: Derive canonical structural index keys from one proposed present row value.
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Any other throw aborts the draft before apply; no source, membership, index, graph, or notification state changes.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable rejects as an invalid synchronous extractor result and produces no prepared delta.
entries.resultBoundary: Only validated inert canonical deltas cross into final no-user-code preflight/apply.

entries.role: Observe one immutable materialization status snapshot after the transition is installed.
suppliedCapabilities: current immutable materialization status snapshot including its progress representation
idempotent unsubscribe for the already-owned status subscription
allowedExternalWork: application scheduling, logging, or progress UI outside Valdres
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. The status transition remains installed; one listener error cannot starve the remaining frozen delivery snapshot, and the first escaping error surfaces after delivery.
entries.thenableRule: The listener is not awaited and no asynchronous Valdres capability survives delivery.
entries.resultBoundary: The listener receives the same opaque immutable status snapshot returned by getMaterializationStatus; its return value is ignored.

entries.role: Read one authoritative synchronous live external snapshot.
allowedExternalWork: pure synchronous read of adapter-owned snapshot state
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. An ordinary non-thenable throw becomes a recoverable external projection error; RuntimeMismatchError remains an exact control fault with host-specific publication rules. Runtime drain non-convergence is owned outside this callback boundary.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes one contained named invalid synchronous snapshot outcome and is never awaited.
entries.resultBoundary: One Object.is-stable live value or error is sampled per admitted generation/transaction capture according to the external lifecycle contract.

entries.role: Read one deterministic server/hydration snapshot for a disposable hydration host.
allowedExternalWork: pure synchronous read of deterministic or transferred adapter seed
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. A non-thenable throw is memoized exactly within the disposable host; a missing reader throws the sticky host-fatal ServerSnapshotUnavailableError with its dependency path.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes the named invalid synchronous server snapshot error and is never a Suspense wakeable.
entries.resultBoundary: Sampled at most once per disposable host and never published into the live graph or external projection.

entries.role: Attach exactly one StoreTree invalidator to an adapter source at aggregate retain 0 to 1.
suppliedCapabilities: one generation-bound invalidator that may only latch during its own startup
allowedExternalWork: start adapter-owned producer when its lifetime policy requires it
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. A throw rolls back provisional admission; a missing, non-function, or thenable cleanup throws InvalidExternalCleanupError. Runtime delivery limits are owned outside this callback boundary.
entries.thenableRule: subscribe itself is synchronous and must return a cleanup function; a thenable setup or cleanup result throws InvalidExternalCleanupError and is never awaited.
entries.resultBoundary: After a valid cleanup is returned, core performs the mandatory second sample and one admission settlement before sub returns.

entries.role: Release one revoked StoreTree invalidator from its adapter source.
allowedExternalWork: stop adapter-owned producer when its lifetime policy requires it
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError. Invalid synchronous cleanup results throw InvalidExternalCleanupError; cleanup remains all-run and ordinary errors join the ordered outer lifecycle ledger after the target is idle or terminal.
entries.thenableRule: A returned or thrown thenable becomes InvalidExternalCleanupError, is never awaited, and cannot add disposeAsync.
entries.resultBoundary: The generation is revoked before invocation and remains revoked regardless of cleanup outcome.

entries.role: Invalidate one final settled subscription target after source and derived state stabilize; the callback receives no arguments.
suppliedCapabilities: zero-argument invalidation signal; no settled value argument
committed reads that do not sample dormant external sources
allowedExternalWork: DOM or application side effects outside Valdres
entries.errorRule: Forbidden same-domain work throws CallbackCapabilityError; a read that would publish a dormant external source throws DormantExternalReadError. Subscriber throws are all collected in deterministic target-reaching and callback-insertion order without starving the remaining snapshot. Without an already-authoritative post-apply RuntimeMismatchError, they surface after idle as SubscriberNotificationError / VALDRES_SUBSCRIBER_NOTIFICATION with immutable cause equal to the exact first thrown value, frozen ordered causes, committed true, phase notifying, and lifecycle-free source owned-mutation. Delivery remains all-fire when that mismatch is already authoritative. If no subscriber throws, the exact RuntimeMismatchError surfaces directly after all callbacks are attempted. If subscriber throws coexist, SubscriberNotificationError is the required outer wrapper with cause equal to the exact RuntimeMismatchError and frozen causes equal to [mismatch, ...subscriber throws in delivery order]; every subscriber throw is retained as a secondary cause in delivery order, and the mismatch remains the semantic primary and is not replaced.
entries.thenableRule: Callback return values are ignored. A returned thenable receives exactly one stateless rejection-containment handler, is never awaited, and does not itself create a notification error. A thrown thenable receives exactly one stateless rejection-containment handler, is never awaited, and remains the exact ordered subscriber cause; no asynchronous Valdres capability survives delivery.
entries.resultBoundary: Store.sub(state, callback: () => void): () => void creates one independent registration even when callback identity repeats. Registration performs the same outcome materialization as get, but internally catches the public read throw of a successfully materialized ordinary current error outcome so it can register; only admission, disposal, or internal-publication failure registers nothing. A lifecycle-free registration does not notify. Changed target callback sets enter the frozen settlement snapshot in first-reaching order and callbacks within each target retain subscription insertion order; every snapshotted registration is attempted at most once. The returned unsubscribe is idempotent, removes future eligibility immediately, and cannot edit the current snapshot.

entries.role: Acquire one keyed async cache entry generation outside the Valdres State contract.
allowedExternalWork: network, IndexedDB, worker, or application async acquisition
entries.errorRule: Exact entry failure/stale/SWR semantics remain a later beta API contract and never alter plain externalAtom behavior.
entries.thenableRule: The beta loader is intentionally async; its Promise is owned by the cache client and never becomes a Valdres State value.
entries.resultBoundary: Latest generation wins inside one client-owned entry; handoff to canonical Store data is a later explicit synchronous transaction.
